vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在成本與擴產：新電價拉高晚間尖峰費率，工廠轉向儲能搭配能源管理；JinkoSolar越南廠前九月虧損7,500億越南盾，凸顯成本壓力。同時AI主機板供應商擬追加7億美元建廠，各地工業區持續擴張，半導體人才培訓（目標5萬名工程師）與客戶品質要求提升成為產能與製程挑戰。
vn-local.summary_en: Cost pressure leads: new tariffs raise evening peak rates, pushing factories toward storage-backed energy management, and JinkoSolar Vietnam lost VND750bn in 9 months. Expansion continues with a $700M AI motherboard plant, new industrial parks, and a 50,000-engineer semiconductor training push.
highlights: 需同時推進綠色轉型與數位化投資
供應鏈原料來源難以追溯佐證
半導體與電子製造人才培訓需求高

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南第417號法令規定，2027年3月起跨境電商進口單筆不超過100萬越盾可免進口關稅，每位購買者全年限額4800萬越盾，涉及進口報關的華商需重新核對申報分類。海關也將於春節前後以數據分析追查企業、貨物與資金流向，加強打擊走私與商業詐欺。另外，中資JinkoSolar越南廠前九個月虧損7,500億越盾，富壽省一家外資廠停產並拖欠約70名工人工資，成本與停產風險仍需留意。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Decree 417 makes cross-border e-commerce imports up to VND1m per shipment duty-free from March 2027, capped at VND48m per buyer per year, so import filings need rechecking. Customs will use data analytics against smuggling and trade fraud around Tet. JinkoSolar Vietnam lost VND750bn in nine months.
highlights: 免稅門檻與申報分類調整，進口報關需重新核對
原料與生產成本上漲，獲利承壓
工廠解散停產，勞工資遣與待遇需依法處理

th-local.summary_zh: 美國擬對泰國等貿易夥伴啟動301產能過剩調查並加徵關稅，泰國擬定18%、最高可達25%，但尚未實際課徵，出口商可透過ART協商，出口成本與訂單風險升高。同時普拉恰武里電子廢棄物非法工廠遭總理下令停電取締，DSI受理14家相關公司案件，合規查核壓力持續。
th-local.summary_en: US plans Section 301 overcapacity tariffs on Thailand and others (proposed 18%, up to 25%), not yet imposed; exporters may negotiate via ART. Meanwhile, the PM ordered an illegal Prachinburi e-waste plant shut, and DSI took up cases on 14 linked firms, raising compliance pressure.
highlights: 美國關稅未定，出口成本與訂單風險升高
新廠擴產，產能導入與產線規劃待同步進行
在地化採購比例提高，本地零組件供應商需同步開發

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南多地出現擴產與新廠投資潮：韓商北寧增資、中車慶和風電葉片廠、海防稀土廠、峴港電池廠與A&C包裝罐新廠投產，新痛點「擴產需同步規劃產能與人力」浮現。太原省加速培訓半導體與AI人才，顯示新產線落地時，產能與人力規劃是製造業的關鍵課題。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam saw a wave of expansions and new plants today: Korean electrical gear in Bac Ninh, CRRC wind blades in Khanh Hoa, rare earths in Hai Phong, batteries in Da Nang. New pain: expansion needs aligned capacity and staffing plans, while Thai Nguyen speeds semiconductor/AI training.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日中資製造商在越南擴產動作明顯：中國中車旗下企業於慶和省興建8條產線的風電葉片工廠，宏發與VinFast合資汽車零件產線於海防投產。擴產需同步規劃產能與人力成為新痛點；同時越南推動數位轉型與ERP，協助中小企業進入核心價值鏈，凸顯本地配套供應商品質成本仍難達大型集團標準。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Chinese manufacturers are expanding in Vietnam: a CRRC unit is building an 8-line wind blade plant in Khanh Hoa, and a Hongfa–VinFast auto parts line started in Hai Phong. Aligning capacity and staffing is a new pain, while Vietnam's ERP push highlights local suppliers' gaps.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國工業部公布11月查出512家工廠違規，總理亦赴巴吞府查核工業廢棄物，發現工廠違令重啟機器，環保與工廠稽查壓力持續升高。同時泰英FTA談判框架加速推進、副總理推動汽車零件與電子業進入日本供應鏈，出口機會擴大，但泰美ART協議可能加劇進口競爭。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's Industry Ministry found 512 factory violations in November, and the PM inspected industrial waste in Pathum Thani, tightening compliance pressure. Meanwhile Thai-UK FTA talks and a push into Japanese supply chains widen export chances, while the Thai-US ART deal may intensify import competition.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅有一則相關訊息：泰國失業人數升至43萬，報告指出自動化導致製造業職缺流失。對在泰華商製造業者而言，這反映自動化正在改變當地人力結構，人資規劃值得留意。今日無新增或持續追蹤的痛點。
th-huashang.summary_en: Only one relevant item today: Thailand's unemployment rose to 430,000, with a report linking manufacturing job losses to automation. For Chinese-owned manufacturers in Thailand, this signals automation reshaping the local workforce, relevant to HR planning. No new or recurring pains today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業新增兩項痛點：專家警示部分大型企業僅有3名IT工程師、數據治理薄弱；紙包裝業被呼籲從賣產品轉向提供永續解決方案。同時雀巢加入P-CRAFT分享溯源經驗，綠色廠房成工業地產新趨勢，同奈與胡志明市持續推動半導體與電子投資，顯示溯源、數位治理與綠色轉型壓力並進。
vn-local.summary_en: New pains today: thin IT staffing and weak data governance at large Vietnamese firms, and packaging makers urged to shift to sustainable solutions. Nestlé joined P-CRAFT on traceability, green factories trend in industrial property, and semiconductor/electronics investment grows in Dong Nai and HCMC.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南政府頒布2026–2030年貿易順差管理計畫，將加強監測重點出口商品與企業，防範原產地欺詐與非法轉運，華商出口廠需強化原產地文件核對。國會亦通過修訂《投資法》，新增半導體、AI、數據中心等高科技特殊投資優惠，2027年3月31日生效；海防春橋工業區稀土材料工廠同步開工。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam's 2026–2030 trade surplus plan will tighten monitoring of key exporters against origin fraud and transshipment, so Chinese-owned exporters must strengthen origin documentation. The amended Investment Law adds high-tech incentives (semiconductors, AI, data centres) from 31 Mar 2027.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國焦點在日資汽車與半導體投資：日本六家車廠計畫投入約1,340億泰銖並朝晶片與AI擴展，阿努廷亦要求日中車廠提高泰國零件採購並技術移轉。本田巴真武里廠已投產新車型。對在泰製造商而言，在地採購比例提高意味本地零組件供應商需同步開發能力。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand focus: six Japanese automakers plan ~THB134bn investment expanding into chips and AI, and Anutin asked Japanese and Chinese carmakers to source more Thai parts and transfer technology. Honda began producing a new model in Prachinburi. Local suppliers must develop capability to meet rising localization.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 泰國總理阿努廷與日、中車廠會談，要求提高泰國零件採購並進行技術移轉；車廠承諾不撤離泰國，BOI公佈豐田、本田等6家車商投資逾1340億銖。車廠另要求政府支持建充電站。對在泰華商零組件廠而言，在地化採購需求升溫，但產能規劃仍需保留彈性。
th-huashang.summary_en: Thai PM Anutin pressed Japanese and Chinese automakers to raise local parts sourcing and transfer technology. Automakers pledged to stay; BOI cited 6 carmakers investing over THB134bn. Automakers also asked for charging-station support. Chinese-owned suppliers face rising localisation demand but must plan flexibly.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南在地層僅2則相關報導。越南糖價低於東南亞，走私糖大量流入，國產甘蔗糖業者面臨售價壓力，新增痛點「走私低價進口衝擊產品售價」。另 Tôn Nam Kim 於胡志明市 Phú Mỹ 投資6,200億越南盾的鋼鐵廠落成投產，年產能逾120萬噸。持續升溫的痛點仍以綠色轉型與數位化並進為首。
vn-local.summary_en: Two relevant items today. Smuggled low-price sugar is flooding Vietnam, squeezing domestic cane sugar prices (new pain P159). Tôn Nam Kim opened a VND 620bn steel plant in Phú Mỹ, HCMC, with 1.2M+ tonnes/year capacity. Green-plus-digital investment remains the top rising pain.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南國會通過勞動法修正案，新增7月27日與11月24日兩天全薪法定假日，2027年3月1日生效，華商工廠需提前調整2027年生產排程與人力成本。另新法自2027年3月1日起取消消防驗收檢查手續，但所有者須自行組織驗收並負責；停業企業歷史營業牌照費及滯納金可依條件免除至2028年6月30日。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam adds two paid holidays (Jul 27, Nov 24), effective Mar 1, 2027, so factories must replan 2027 schedules and labour costs. Fire inspection checks end from Mar 2027 but owners must self-run acceptance. Suspended firms may get old licence fees waived until Jun 30, 2028.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：汽車業在經濟不確定、地緣緊張與價格戰下加速轉向新能源車；工業聯合會支持加強工業廢棄物稽查並提出四項源頭與末端方案；調查指出高技能人才缺口約100萬人。另有汽車零組件業者嘗試進軍太空產業，顯示提升技術與高值製造的需求上升。
th-local.summary_en: Thai auto makers shift fast to EVs amid uncertainty and price wars; FTI backs tougher industrial waste inspections with four solutions; a survey finds a ~1M high-skill talent gap, worst in aviation and logistics; auto-parts firms eye the space industry, signaling higher-value manufacturing needs.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業動態以產能擴張與綠色轉型為主：胡志明市一座投資6,200億越南盾、年產能約120萬噸的鋼板廠落成；嘉士伯越南推動富巴啤酒廠綠色轉型，對應集團2040年淨零目標。慶和省另將審議半導體晶片設計補助，每案最高120億越南盾。綠色轉型與數位化須同步推進（P029）仍是持續升溫的痛點。
vn-local.summary_en: Today: a VND620bn, ~1.2m-ton/yr steel sheet plant opened in HCMC; Carlsberg Vietnam is greening its Phu Bai brewery toward 2040 net zero; Khanh Hoa may fund chip design up to VND12bn per project. Pursuing green and digital transformation together (P029) keeps rising.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
vn-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：日立因新電力發展計畫（PDP）與資料中心帶動變壓器需求，擴建Bang Pu廠，凸顯新廠擴產與產線規劃需同步推進；水泥商ปูนอินทรี則以員工自主成長因應技術快速變化與培訓跟不上的問題。另「Team Thailand」赴日招商，主打汽車、晶片與太空產業，可能帶來新一波投資。
th-local.summary_en: Hitachi is expanding its Bang Pu plant on transformer demand from the new PDP and data centers, highlighting expansion planning needs. Cement maker ปูนอินทรี uses self-directed learning as training lags tech change. Team Thailand pitched autos, chips and space in Japan.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日最大變化為歐盟對越南冷軋扁鋼課徵16%反傾銷稅（11月17日起生效），出口價格競爭力受壓。同時魚露業導入原料溯源、包裝業被要求達國際標準，顯示出口市場對溯源與品質永續要求持續升高；Carlsberg屋頂太陽能則呼應綠色轉型與數位化並進的壓力。
vn-local.summary_en: EU anti-dumping duties of 16% on Vietnamese cold-rolled flat steel (effective Nov 17) hit export competitiveness. Fish sauce makers adopt raw-material traceability and packaging exporters face international standards, while Carlsberg's rooftop solar reflects green-transition pressure.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南國會通過企業所得稅法、投資法等多項修法，華商需重新檢視稅務減免條件與申報。香港理文造紙芹苴廠原料倉庫深夜起火、約2萬平方米過火，凸顯倉儲防火管理風險。另關稅調整影響出口成本的議題持續升溫。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam's National Assembly passed amendments to corporate income tax, investment and related laws, so Chinese-owned firms must recheck tax incentives and filings. A fire at Lee & Man's Can Tho paper mill raw-material warehouse burned about 20,000 m². Tariff-driven export cost concerns keep rising.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點在擴產與在地化：CP-Meiji投資48億泰銖於沙拉武里興建第3座工廠，年產能增加25萬噸；BYD擴大泰國電動車生產並提高在地零組件採購。同時中小企業擔憂美國商品大量進口衝擊本地生產，成本與售價壓力浮現；台灣亦在METALEX 2026展示智慧製造方案。
th-local.summary_en: Thai manufacturing today: CP-Meiji invests THB 4.8bn in a third Saraburi plant (+250k tons/yr); BYD expands Thai EV output and local content sourcing. SMEs fear a surge of US imports hurting local producers. Taiwan showcased smart manufacturing at METALEX 2026.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關消息：BYD確認擴大泰國電動車生產基地，並提高在地零組件採購比例。對在泰華商製造業而言，這意味著本地供應商需同步開發與認證，採購與供應鏈管理壓力上升；同時出口管制合規與關稅成本不確定性等痛點持續升溫。
th-huashang.summary_en: One relevant item today: BYD confirmed expanding its Thai EV production base and raising local component sourcing. For Chinese-owned manufacturers in Thailand, this pushes local supplier development and procurement upgrades, while export-control compliance and tariff uncertainty pains keep rising.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點仍是綠色轉型與數位化並進（P029），嘉士伯、TH集團、鋼鐵與膠黏劑業者紛紛推動減塑、太陽能與綠色生產。新出現的痛點是安全管理：西寧省塑膠廠倉庫大火，加上年底高溫期用電安全與節電受關注；南部工業地產因AI與半導體需求升溫，租戶更重視電力與綠色標準。
vn-local.summary_en: Green-plus-digital transformation (P029) stays dominant: Carlsberg, TH Group, steel and adhesive makers push plastic cuts, solar and greener output. New pains: a Tay Ninh plastics warehouse fire and year-end power-safety/cost concerns. Southern industrial parks see demand tied to power and green standards.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 華新麗華宣布為AI液冷供應鏈客戶在越南設不銹鋼精密材料基地，一年內完成建廠與設備導入，凸顯台商擴產速度與產能、人力壓力。同時越南第412/2026號法令於11月14日簽署，無環保許可最高罰10億越南盾，在越華商須盡快補齊環保許可與登記。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Walsin Lihwa will set up a stainless precision materials base in Vietnam for AI liquid-cooling customers, with equipment in within a year, underscoring capacity pressure. Decree 412/2026, signed Nov 14, raises fines to VND 1 billion for operating without environmental permits.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國製造業今日焦點在貿易與合規風險：工業聯合會警告美國關稅未定，汽車零件恐面臨50%關稅；BOI評估美國晶片出口管制影響有限，但高階零組件合規壓力持續。同時正大與Bunge以區塊鏈追溯原料，METALEX聚焦AI導入工廠，顯示溯源與智慧製造需求上升。
th-local.summary_en: Thai manufacturers face trade risk: FTI warns auto parts may face 50% US tariffs, while BOI sees limited impact from US chip export controls. CP-Bunge blockchain traceability and METALEX's AI-in-factory focus signal rising demand for traceability and smart manufacturing.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 美國商務部公布新一輪先進AI晶片出口管制，將泰國、新加坡、馬來西亞等納入範圍；泰國投資促進委員會則評估對泰國影響有限。對在泰華商製造業而言，出口管制與轉運審查趨嚴，供應鏈合規審查需強化。另泰國與比亞迪、騰訊及日本洽談合作，產業合作動能持續。
th-huashang.summary_en: The US announced new advanced AI chip export controls covering Thailand, Singapore and Malaysia; Thailand's BOI sees limited impact. For Chinese-owned manufacturers in Thailand, tighter export and transshipment scrutiny raises compliance needs. Thailand also met BYD, Tencent and Japan on cooperation.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在廠房與用地：外資偏好現成廠房以縮短建廠時程，海防公開逾465公頃工業用地，慶和省補助中小企業租金。同時電價調整成本壓力持續上升，SCG強調綠色生產須兼顧成本，環保法修正草案也將調整交通工具回收責任，製造商需同步檢視擴產、能源與合規規劃。
vn-local.summary_en: Factory space dominated: FDI firms favour ready-built plants, Hai Phong opened 465+ ha of industrial land, Khanh Hoa will subsidise SME rent. Power-price pressure is rising, SCG says green output must stay cost-competitive, and a draft law shifts vehicle recycling duties.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 歐盟對台灣、越南等國冷軋鋼品課徵最終反傾銷稅（台灣20.7%至27%），17日起生效，關稅壓力持續升溫；越南海關公布通關後原產地核查流程（12月15日起），外國勞工免辦工作許可新規12月5日起生效。同時液冷散熱供應鏈在越南快速擴產，南紡調整越台產線停產低毛利品，華商需同步因應合規與產能重配。
vn-huashang.summary_en: EU final anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled steel from Taiwan, Vietnam and others took effect on the 17th. Vietnam set post-clearance origin checks (from Dec 15) and new work-permit exemptions (from Dec 5). The liquid-cooling supply chain is expanding fast in Vietnam.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國焦點集中在泰日產業合作：BOI與泰國工業聯合會積極爭取日本在電動車、半導體與汽車領域投資，並提出年產195萬輛的汽車振興策略，同時強調保護本土零件供應。另一方面，美國擬收緊高階晶片出口與轉運管制，泰國電子與車用零組件廠的合規風險隨之升高。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand-Japan cooperation dominated: BOI and FTI court Japanese EV, chip and auto investment, with a plan for 1.95M vehicles/year while protecting local parts suppliers. Meanwhile, planned US curbs on advanced chip exports and transshipment raise compliance risk for component makers.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 美國擴大先進晶片出口與轉運管制，泰國等五國的先進運算產品需事先取得許可，在泰華商的高階零組件合規審查壓力上升。美泰貿易協定雖有突破，但川普稱泰國將取消美國商品關稅、泰方予以駁斥，關稅細節仍未定，出口成本難以預估。英業達子公司獲BOI批准追加投資，顯示台廠仍持續加碼泰國。
th-huashang.summary_en: US export controls on advanced chips now cover Thailand and four others, raising transshipment and compliance risk for Chinese-owned makers. A US-Thai trade deal advanced, but tariff details are disputed, keeping export costs unclear. Inventec's subsidiary won BOI approval for more investment.

th-huashang.summary_en: Classification failed; 6 items stay pending and will be retried.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業以擴產投資為主：韓資EV Advanced Materials擴大越南電動車電路板產能、三養食品選定北寧設第二海外基地、北寧半掛車廠擬投資1000億越盾建新廠。同時，半導體人才與實作技能培育仍是自動化瓶頸，HSBC調查指能源已成全球企業最大成本壓力，新廠規劃需及早納入人才與成本管理。
vn-local.summary_en: Expansion dominates: EV Advanced Materials grows Vietnam EV circuit board capacity, Samyang picks Bac Ninh for a new plant, a semi-trailer maker plans a VND100bn factory. Skills gaps in semiconductors and automation persist, and HSBC says energy is now firms' top cost pressure.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關訊息：越南紡織服裝業力爭2026年出口額達480至490億美元，並同步重構供應鏈、推進綠色與數位轉型。對在越華商製造業而言，原產地規則嚴格、原料供應不足仍是享受關稅優惠的障礙（P099持續出現），而關稅調整與原產地文件查核等議題熱度上升，值得持續關注。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Only one relevant item today: Vietnam's textile and garment sector targets USD 48–49 billion in 2026 exports while restructuring supply chains and pushing green and digital transformation. Strict rules of origin and short material supply remain a recurring barrier to tariff benefits.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國投資申請連續55季成長，政府赴日、韓招商，鎖定汽車、電子與電動車零件；XPeng也考慮在泰設廠。Delta泰國廠轉向高附加價值製造並加強本地研發，Kawasaki新機器人控制器強化資安以符合歐盟網路韌性法，顯示製造商須同步提升研發與出口合規能力。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's investment applications grew for a 55th straight quarter as officials courted Japan and Korea. Delta's Thai plant is shifting to higher-value manufacturing with local R&D, and Kawasaki added security features to meet the EU Cyber Resilience Act. R&D and compliance now matter more.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日台資與中資製造商在泰國動態集中於升級與擴產：Delta 泰國廠轉向高附加價值製造並強化本地研發以因應營運壓力；健和興泰國廠受惠東南亞訂單擴增；XPeng 銷量破萬輛並考慮在泰設廠。技術要求提高成為新痛點，華商需提升研發與高值製造能力。
th-huashang.summary_en: Chinese-owned makers in Thailand focus on upgrading and expansion: Delta's Thai plant shifts to higher-value manufacturing and local R&D under operating pressure; Kenly's Thai plant gains from SEA orders; XPeng weighs a Thai factory. Rising tech demands emerge as a new pain.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日僅2則相關報導：興安省一家銅管製造商與中國大型集團正面競爭價格，凸顯本地製造商面臨中資低價壓力（新痛點P135）。另越南紡織業依全球趨勢推動綠色轉型，呼應出口市場對品質與永續要求持續提高（P035）。智慧工廠、稅務與電子發票遵循等議題亦在升溫。
vn-local.summary_en: Only 2 relevant items today: a Hung Yen copper pipe maker competes with large Chinese groups, highlighting price pressure on local manufacturers (new pain P135). Vietnam's textile sector pursues green transition, echoing rising export quality and sustainability demands (P035).

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅2則相關訊息：歐盟對部分混合動力汽車產品啟動保障措施調查，延續關稅調整影響出口成本與接單的趨勢（P026累計11次）；越南工商聯合會建議欠稅暫緩出境應限於超門檻且已有效送達者，提醒華商企業及時更新稅號狀態、處理欠稅與地址登記。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Only 2 relevant items today. The EU opened a safeguard investigation into some hybrid vehicle products, adding to tariff pressure on export costs and orders (P026, 11 mentions). VCCI proposed limiting exit bans for tax arrears to above-threshold, properly notified cases, so tax records need prompt updating.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國在地層僅有1則相關報導：巴真府抗議者要求政府停止東部經濟走廊(EEC)擴張計畫，可能影響在EEC布局或擴廠的製造商評估。今日無新增或重複痛點，但環保稽查趨嚴(P034)與自動化人才轉型不足(P041)持續上升。
th-local.summary_en: Only one relevant item today: protesters in Prachinburi urged the government to halt Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) expansion, a signal for manufacturers planning EEC investment. No new or recurring pains, but environmental enforcement (P034) and automation skills gaps (P041) keep rising.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南在地製造動態以胡志明市新投資為主：中國輪胎大廠Zhongce Rubber規劃投資5億美元建廠、另一中國科技集團簽約興建萬坪級高科技廠房，市委書記亦考察無人機製造商。Heineken越南第三季銷量與營收雙位數成長，凸顯需求快速成長時產能調度跟不上的新痛點；Hòa Phát成立再生能源公司，呼應持續升溫的電價成本議題。
vn-local.summary_en: HCMC drew new factory investment (Zhongce's USD 500M tyre plant, a Chinese tech group's 10,000 m² facility). Heineken Vietnam's double-digit Q3 growth flags a new pain: demand outpacing scheduling. Hòa Phát's renewable-energy unit echoes rising power-cost concerns.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅2則相關新聞（皆來自cafef.vn），顯示陸資製造業持續加碼胡志明市：一家中國科技集團簽約興建10,000平方米高科技廠房，中策橡膠（Zhongce Rubber）則規劃投資5億美元建廠，年產650萬條輪胎。今日無新增或持續痛點，但關稅調整、法定假日排程與原產地文件核對等痛點正在升溫，新進廠商建廠時應同步規劃因應。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Two items today, both from cafef.vn: mainland Chinese manufacturers are expanding in HCMC, with a tech group's 10,000 m² high-tech plant and Zhongce Rubber's US$500M tire plant (6.5M tires/yr). There are no new pains. Tariff, holiday-scheduling and origin-document pains are rising.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國焦點在泰中經貿：Leap 於羅勇府 Chery 工廠開始組裝汽車以因應電動車稅負調升；泰中圓桌會議提出加速ACFTA 3.0，前九個月中國BOI申請近500件；商務部長推動中企增購泰國零組件並加快泰歐FTA談判。對在地製造商而言，代工與零組件供應中資的機會擴大，汽車業則需重估組裝產能與布局。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand-China trade dominated: Leap began assembly at Chery's Rayong plant amid higher EV taxes; a roundtable urged faster ACFTA 3.0, with nearly 500 Chinese BOI applications in 9 months; Thailand pushes Chinese firms to buy local parts and speeds Thai-EU FTA talks.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 泰國電動車稅負調升，Leap已於羅勇府Chery工廠開始組裝，華商車廠需重新評估產能與設廠地點。泰中經貿會議推動中國企業採用泰國原料與零組件、加速ACFTA 3.0，今年前九個月中國BOI申請近500件；第3季實際投資額年增28%，政府將推動人才培育與供應鏈在地化，在地供應與技能升級成為華商重點課題。
th-huashang.summary_en: Thailand's EV tax hike pushed Leap to start assembly at Chery's Rayong plant. Thai-China talks push local parts sourcing and ACFTA 3.0, with nearly 500 Chinese BOI applications in 9 months; Q3 investment rose 28%, with government focus on talent and supply-chain localisation.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南木製家具業焦點：越南產品在Wayfair銷售佔比高，但越南生產企業實際僅獲約8億美元收入，凸顯代工難提升附加價值；專家指出同一產品有數十家供應商競爭，企業需具備生產與報價以外的能力才能贏得美國客戶。另有廣寧6.9億美元新廠投資，以及汽車保固條件法令修訂徵求意見。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam's wood furniture makers earn only ~US$800M despite a large Wayfair share, showing OEM value limits; experts say beating dozens of rival suppliers for US buyers needs capabilities beyond production and quoting. Also: a US$690M Quang Ninh plant and draft auto warranty rules.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南自2026年11月12日至2027年2月28日推動打擊走私與商業欺詐專項行動，加強進出口與原產地查核，華商出口廠需及早強化原產地文件核對。另胡志明市計畫新增無人機設備生產廠。關稅調整（P026）持續升溫，影響出口成本與接單。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam runs an anti-smuggling and trade-fraud campaign from Nov 12, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027, tightening import-export and origin checks, so exporters must verify origin documents. HCMC also plans new drone equipment plants. Tariff-driven cost pressure (P026) keeps rising.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰中簽署八項合作，涵蓋EV投資與勞工技能發展；BOI公布第三季實際投資年增28%，全年預估破1兆泰銖，自動化與人才升級需求隨之升溫。環保管控持續趨嚴，工業部擬加強礦物進出口管制，工業聯合會推動廢棄物PRO系統；石化業則擔憂泰UAE FTA降稅過快衝擊原料成本。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand-China signed 8 pacts spanning EV investment and skills; BOI says Q3 actual investment rose 28%, full year seen above THB1 trillion. Environmental controls tighten (mineral trade rules, FTI waste PRO model), while petrochemical firms fear fast Thai-UAE FTA tariff cuts on PE/PP imports.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 泰中簽署八項合作文件，涵蓋EV產業投資、汽車產業升級與勞工技能/職業教育，對在泰華商而言，自動化與人才升級壓力持續。工業部擬強化邊境礦物進出口管制以防跨境污染，環保合規要求趨嚴；BOI與長城汽車(GWM)Sourcing Day促成71組零件配對，國產化比例提升帶來供應商認證壓力。
th-huashang.summary_en: Thailand-China signed eight cooperation documents covering EV investment, auto upgrading and skills training, keeping automation and talent pressure high. Industry ministry plans tighter border mineral controls against cross-border pollution; BOI-GWM Sourcing Day made 71 matches to raise local parts content.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日焦點為外資持續擴大在越布局：同奈前10月吸引逾25億美元FDI，日企在胡志明市尋求人力對接與程序協助，泰國食品集團因母國工廠火災改由越南廠承接供應。同時工業部調高LNG發電最高躉售價，政府鼓勵FDI增加採購本地供應商，製造商需同步關注用電成本、稅務遵循與切入外資供應鏈的機會。
vn-local.summary_en: FDI keeps expanding: Dong Nai drew over $2.5B in 10 months, Japanese firms in HCMC seek workforce and procedure support, and a Thai food group shifted supply to its Vietnam plant after fires at home. LNG power price caps rose, while the government urges FDI firms to buy from local suppliers.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日重點在越南北部與中部的招商動態：北寧與近200家中國企業舉行對話會，中國為當地外資項目數量最多的來源國，並成立13人China Desk工作組；VSIP合資公司獲准投資3,525億越南盾建設峴港自由貿易區功能區基礎設施。對評估在越設廠或擴產的華商而言，選址與供應鏈對接的選項正在增加。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Bac Ninh met nearly 200 Chinese firms, where China leads in FDI project count, and set up a 13-person China Desk. VSIP was approved to invest VND 352.5bn in Da Nang FTZ infrastructure. Chinese-owned manufacturers gain more siting and supply-chain options.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：Rockwell推出新款HMI，主打舊設備不停產升級並兼顧資安，反映設備升級與資安需求浮現；EA展示商用電動車量產就緒，汽車零件EV轉型持續；泰國因375家工廠違規，目標12月內閣審議電子廢棄物管制，環保稽查壓力升高。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand: Rockwell's new HMI targets no-downtime legacy upgrades with cyber security; EA shows commercial EV mass-production readiness as auto-parts EV shift continues; Thailand aims for December cabinet review of e-waste rules after 375 factories violated them.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 美國商務部擬將半導體與AI晶片出口管制擴及泰國、新加坡、馬來西亞等七國，在泰華商須強化供應鏈合規審查。泰國同時加速汽車產業在地化，BOI配對71組企業，並將與中方簽署汽車合作備忘錄；泰美關稅協議細節未定，出口成本仍難預估。
th-huashang.summary_en: US plans to extend chip export controls to Thailand and six others, raising compliance pressure. Thailand pushes auto localization (BOI matched 71 firm pairs) and a China auto MOU, while Thai-US tariff details remain pending, keeping export costs uncertain.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在外資擴廠與綠色轉型：Samyang擬於北寧投資約4,200億越南盾建新廠，FPT與SBI研究河內晶片封測廠。SCG長信石化因改用美國進口原料延至2027年中投產，凸顯原料依賴進口風險；綠色建築認證中工業廠房與倉庫占近四成，綠色基礎設施已成競爭條件。
vn-local.summary_en: FDI expansion and green transition lead today: Samyang plans a ~VND420bn Bac Ninh plant; FPT and SBI study a Hanoi chip packaging plant. SCG's Long Son petrochemical project slips to mid-2027 after switching to US feedstock, showing import-dependence risk. Green-certified factories now near 40% of certifications.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南海關加強審查中國產HS 7308鋼結構的進口申報價格、原產地與標籤，且可追查已通關報單，華商原產地文件核對壓力持續升高。胡志明市推動南部各省整合原料、製造、物流與出口環節，並與海鮮加工企業就土地規劃與建廠問題對話。亞洲鋼價12月平高盤築底，影響採購規劃。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam Customs is tightening checks on Chinese HS 7308 steel structure imports (declared value, origin, labels) and can audit cleared declarations. HCMC is pushing southern regional supply chain integration and held talks with seafood processors on land planning. Asian steel prices are bottoming out.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國工業部成立4個專案小組取締非法工廠與違法外籍人士，泰國工業聯合會也要求工廠對工業廢棄物負責到最終處置，合規壓力同步升高。BOI與長城汽車採購日讓76家泰國供應商洽談本地採購，供應商認證需求浮現；另有機台資料記錄器主打追查故障原因，凸顯設備數據管理的缺口。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's Industry Ministry set up 4 task forces against illegal factories and non-compliant foreigners, while FTI wants factories liable for waste to final disposal. A BOI–GWM sourcing day drew 76 Thai suppliers, and a new machine data logger targets hard-to-trace equipment failures.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 泰國工業部成立4個專案小組，打擊非法工廠並驅逐違法外籍人士、加重刑罰，在泰華商的合規查核壓力上升。同時BOI與長城汽車辦採購日推動汽車零件在地採購，廣達、富喬持續擴大泰國產能，富喬新廠產能已被訂滿，供應商認證與產能承諾成為關鍵課題。
th-huashang.summary_en: Thailand's Industry Ministry formed 4 task forces against illegal factories and violating foreigners, raising compliance pressure. BOI and GWM pushed local auto-part sourcing, while Quanta and Fulltech expand Thai capacity, making supplier qualification and capacity commitments key.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在法規收緊：食品安全法修訂、欠稅暫停出境規範、企業棄廠時員工薪資保證金提案，合規與人資壓力同步升高。另二手電子設備進口禁令將於2027年1月1日生效，料源需調整；越日在半導體與電子領域合作持續，為本地企業切入外資供應鏈帶來機會。
vn-local.summary_en: Regulation tightens for Vietnam manufacturers: food safety law revision, tax-debt exit bans, and a proposed wage deposit for abandoned factories. A used-electronics import ban starts 1 Jan 2027, while Vietnam–Japan semiconductor and electronics deals open supply-chain entry points.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅兩則訊息，皆為延續性痛點。2026年1-9月中國大陸在越南新增製造業投資項目281個，年減43.2%，反映關稅調整下華商投資轉趨謹慎；越南國會討論將7月27日列為帶薪假日，全年帶薪假由11天增至13天，將影響生產排程與人力成本。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Two items today, both recurring pains. New mainland Chinese manufacturing projects in Vietnam fell 43.2% to 281 in Jan–Sep 2026 amid tariff shifts. The National Assembly is discussing making July 27 a paid holiday, raising paid holidays from 11 to 13 days, affecting scheduling.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：泰國躋身全球勒索軟體攻擊前十國，製造業為主要目標，工廠資安壓力升溫；泰中擬簽MOU共建汽車產業基地並發展職業教育，EV轉型與人才培育同步推進；10月生產者物價指數上漲10.2%，能源與泰銖走弱推高成本，調價壓力加大。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand ranks among the top 10 ransomware targets, with manufacturing hit most. Thai-China MOUs on an EV/smart-auto hub and vocational education push EV and skills shifts. October PPI rose 10.2% on energy prices and a weak baht, raising cost pressure.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 泰國工業部長下令加強全國工業廢料處理及回收工廠的檢查與執法，在泰華商需強化廢料合規。同時泰中擬簽MOU共建汽車產業基地、推動EV與智慧汽車，汽車零件轉型EV的壓力持續上升；台商投資研討會則聚焦跨國人才與稅務議題。
th-huashang.summary_en: Thailand's industry minister ordered stricter nationwide inspections of industrial waste and recycling plants. A planned Thailand-China MOU on an auto hub adds EV transition pressure on parts makers. A Taiwanese investment seminar focused on cross-border talent and tax.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日焦點為日本地方企業持續赴越尋求合作：愛知縣受邀擴大在胡志明市投資，群馬縣約30家企業赴海防洽談汽車與精密機械配套，對想切入外資供應鏈的本地廠是機會。政府提出減輕稅務遵循負擔與支援電子發票的措施（新痛點）；河內撥款500億越盾發放數位轉型支援券。
vn-local.summary_en: Japanese prefectures keep courting Vietnam: Aichi firms invited to HCMC, ~30 Gunma firms seek auto/precision-machinery partners in Hai Phong—openings for local suppliers. Government proposes easing tax compliance and supporting e-invoices (new pain); Hanoi funds VND50bn in digital-transformation vouchers.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南工貿部提出2027年北部削減約3,000MW尖峰用電並鼓勵錯峰生產，加上11月24日越南文化日放假照發工資，華商工廠需重新規劃排班與出勤。同時，越南對中國、印尼、台灣冷軋不鏽鋼啟動反傾銷調查（9個HS編碼），勞工短缺與勞動力老化問題持續，影響採購成本與生產率。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam's MOIT plans to cut ~3,000MW of northern peak load in 2027 and urges off-peak production; Nov 24 Culture Day is a paid holiday. An anti-dumping probe on cold-rolled stainless steel from China, Indonesia and Taiwan covers 9 HS codes. Labour shortages and aging workforce persist.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國EV政策持續牽動製造業：35%EV稅與消費稅局修訂EV皮卡國產零件條件，推動中國EV品牌加速在泰設廠，汽車零件業轉型EV的壓力上升。另有MOU U-TURN配套放寬緬甸與寮國外籍勞工（在泰國工作的外國人）合法引進程序，食品業減碳減塑要求也在提高，值得人資與ESG部門關注。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's 35% EV tax and revised excise rules on EV pickup parts push Chinese EV brands to build local plants, raising pressure on auto-parts makers to shift to EV. MOU U-TURN eases legal entry of Myanmar and Lao foreign workers in Thailand; food makers face tougher carbon and plastic goals.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 泰國對EV課徵35%稅，促使中國EV品牌加速在泰設廠，零跑（LEAPMOTOR）赴BOI洽談建廠，中資ZD Energy擴建春武里工廠，汽車零件業者轉型EV的產線與技能調整壓力上升。同時泰國推出MOU U-TURN配套，放寬緬甸與寮國勞工合法引進程序，華商可藉此緩解缺工。
th-huashang.summary_en: Thailand's 35% EV tax is pushing Chinese EV brands to build local plants; LEAPMOTOR met BOI and ZD Energy expands in Chonburi, raising pressure on auto parts makers to shift to EV. New MOU U-TURN measures ease legal hiring of Myanmar and Lao foreign workers in Thailand.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業動態以人力重整與能源成本為主：ECCO越南解散後，Biti's接收40名聽障員工，反映工廠停產後的人力再配置議題；2026年太陽能電價框架公布，被定位為工業綠色轉型推力。另有外資擴產先進材料、Kokuyo入股Thiên Long整合產銷。
vn-local.summary_en: Today's Vietnam manufacturing news centres on workforce redeployment and energy costs. After ECCO Vietnam's dissolution, Biti's will take in 40 hearing-impaired staff. A 2026 solar power price framework was announced to drive green transition. Kokuyo took a stake in Thiên Long.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
vn-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國媒體報導網路攻擊平均每日12次，製造業名列10大高風險產業，工廠資安成為今日新痛點。政府擬將巴真武里流域劃為污染控制區，加強重金屬檢測與源頭工廠稽查，環保合規壓力持續。另Garmin宣布於春武里府設立泰國首座工廠，預計2026年第四季投產。
th-local.summary_en: Thai media report 12 cyberattacks a day on average, with manufacturing among the 10 highest-risk industries. Prachinburi river basin may become a pollution control zone with stricter heavy-metal testing and factory audits. Garmin plans its first Thai plant in Chonburi, producing from Q4 2026.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關訊息：高力因AI資料中心需求，加快台灣與泰國產能布局，橋科新廠投資32.5億元，最快2027年量產。這反映客戶重視產能承諾、要求持續大量交貨的新痛點，在泰台商需提前規劃跨廠產能與交付能力。
th-huashang.summary_en: One relevant item today: Kaori is accelerating capacity in Taiwan and Thailand on AI data center demand, investing NT$3.25B in a new plant with mass production as early as 2027. It signals a new pain: customers value capacity commitments and sustained large-volume delivery.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南在地新聞以產能擴張與綠色轉型為主：廣治省2,669億越南盾包裝廠投產、Nhôm Việt Dũng第三座廠落成（逾10萬平方公尺），越南亦推動工業群聚綠色永續發展。歐盟CBAM引發歐印貿易摩擦，提醒出口型製造商須及早因應品質與永續要求（P035）。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam news today centers on capacity expansion and green transition: a VND 266.9bn packaging plant opened in Quang Tri, Nhom Viet Dung inaugurated its third plant (100,000+ m²), and Vietnam is pushing green, sustainable industrial clusters. EU CBAM tensions with India signal rising sustainability demands for exporters (P035).

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關資訊：越南駐華大使表示歡迎中國投資者赴越，擴大面料及配套產業的高品質投資，對評估赴越布局的陸資紡織供應鏈廠商是正面訊號。另外，「訂單增加，產能與人力跟不上」（P033）列為上升痛點，累計出現4次，值得持續關注。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Only one relevant item today: Vietnam's ambassador to China welcomed Chinese investors to expand high-quality investment in fabrics and supporting industries, a positive signal for Chinese textile supply-chain firms eyeing Vietnam. Rising pain P033 (orders up, capacity and staffing lagging) appeared 4 times.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國在地層僅1則相關報導：泰國工業聯合會隨政府代表團赴日，與JETRO商談擴大產業合作，並推動汽車零件延伸至太空產業，對接單與新市場布局的業務團隊值得關注。另外，「供應鏈回流本土，新供應商認證與產能導入壓力增加」（P087）為上升痛點，累計3次。
th-local.summary_en: One relevant Thai item today: the Federation of Thai Industries joined a government delegation to Japan to discuss wider industrial cooperation with JETRO and extending auto parts into the space industry. Rising pain P087 (reshoring, supplier qualification and capacity ramp-up) counted 3.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在供應穩定。義安省協助企業解決電力與原料供應受阻，屬今日新痛點。中國收緊鎢出口，Hyundai擬在越投資電池原料廠以降低對中國依賴，凸顯原料仰賴進口的風險。另外，智慧製造被視為串連數位與綠色轉型的橋樑；胡志明市、富壽省推動永續生產，台灣企業代表團則洽談自動化與智慧製造合作。
vn-local.summary_en: Supply stability led today. Nghe An is helping firms with blocked power and raw material supply (a new pain). China tightened tungsten exports, and Hyundai plans a battery-material plant in Vietnam to cut reliance on China. Smart manufacturing is framed as the bridge between digital and green transition.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅兩則相關消息：台灣企業代表團11月4日赴越交流投資環境，洽談自動化、智慧製造與供應鏈合作；另有中國集團擬追加投資1.200 tỷ越南盾，將越南高科技材料年產能擴至3.5萬噸。顯示華商在越持續擴產，製造競爭力愈發仰賴技術整合，而「訂單增加、產能人力跟不上」的痛點正在上升。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Two relevant items: a Taiwanese business delegation discussed automation, smart manufacturing and supply-chain cooperation in Vietnam on Nov 4, and a Chinese group plans a VND 1,200bn expansion to 35,000 t/yr. Chinese-owned firms keep scaling up; tech integration and capacity strain are rising pains.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國焦點在EV轉型：汽車零件業受EV投資浪潮衝擊，約75萬名勞工就業受影響，產線與技能需同步調整。同時BOI與工業聯合會推動半導體與Data Center供應鏈在地化，新供應商認證與產能導入壓力持續上升；央行亦預期MPI修訂將使今年GDP成長增加0.1至0.5個百分點。
th-local.summary_en: Thai auto parts makers face EV-driven restructuring affecting about 750,000 workers. BOI and FTI push local semiconductor and data center supply chains, raising supplier qualification pressure. The central bank expects MPI revisions to add 0.1–0.5 pts to GDP growth.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在供應鏈切入與成本壓力：Viettel製造公司表示越南已準備進入全球航空供應鏈，IEAE Hanoi展會主打連結全球供應鏈；日本魚板原料價格翻倍，凸顯原料成本議題持續升溫。另AMECC第三季獲利大增約8.5倍但存貨增至逾2,000億越南盾，提醒廠商留意庫存與資金周轉。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam manufacturing news centred on supply-chain entry and cost pressure: Viettel's manufacturing arm says Vietnam is ready for global aerospace supply chains, and raw material costs keep rising. AMECC's Q3 profit jumped ~8.5x while inventory topped VND 200 billion, a working-capital warning.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關消息：越南下調汽油特別消費稅，並自2026年11月1日起將平均零售電價下調2%，可望減輕華商製造業的能源與物流成本壓力。另一方面，「訂單增加，產能與人力跟不上」痛點持續升溫（4次），顯示產能規劃仍是關注重點。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Only one relevant item today: Vietnam cut the special consumption tax on gasoline and lowered average retail electricity prices by 2% from Nov 1, 2026, easing energy costs for manufacturers. Meanwhile, the pain 'orders rising, capacity and labour can't keep up' is rising (4 mentions).

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：P&G與Siemens擴大導入AI視覺檢測，報告指不良品可降20%，凸顯換線需重設視覺檢測的新痛點。另EVAT傳出支持對進口電動車加徵35%稅以保護本地汽車產業，Bosch泰國羅勇廠慶30週年。環保稽查與能源運輸成本壓力持續升溫。
th-local.summary_en: P&G and Siemens are expanding AI vision inspection globally, reporting a 20% defect cut, highlighting a new pain: re-setup at changeovers. EVAT reportedly backs a 35% tax on imported EVs; Bosch Thailand marks 30 years in Rayong. Environmental audits and energy costs keep rising.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅有一則相關資訊，且無新增或持續性痛點：泰國電動車協會建議對進口電動車課徵35%消費稅，以推動產業升級。對在泰國或計畫赴泰設廠的華商而言，此建議若落實，可能影響進口與在地生產的佈局考量，建議持續關注法規與關務動態。
th-huashang.summary_en: One relevant item today and no new or recurring pains: Thailand's EV association proposed a 35% excise tax on imported EVs to drive industry upgrading. If adopted, it could shape import-versus-local-production decisions for Chinese-owned makers in Thailand.

vn-local.summary_zh: 越南自11月1日起平均下調零售電價2%並調整尖離峰時段，工廠需重新檢視用電排程；逾20家銀行調降新貸利率0.2至0.5個百分點，央行要求資金投向生產經營。另規劃2027年起禁止進口部分手機與電腦，電子業料源與合規需提早因應；ECCO越南廠清算停產影響逾1,600名員工。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam cut retail power prices 2% from Nov 1 with revised peak/off-peak hours. Over 20 banks lowered new loan rates 0.2–0.5 points as the central bank steers credit to production. A planned 2027 ban on some phone/PC imports affects electronics sourcing. ECCO's closure hits 1,600+ workers.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日越南紡織服裝業傳出原產地規則嚴格、原料供應不足，難以充分享用CPTPP關稅優惠，成為華商新痛點。同時「訂單增加，產能與人力跟不上」持續升溫；胡志明市11月4日5場工業展開幕、逾800家企業參展，顯示接單與供應鏈在地化壓力並存。
vn-huashang.summary_en: New pain today: strict origin rules and thin raw supply keep Vietnam's textile sector from fully using CPTPP tariff cuts. Rising orders outpacing capacity and labour keeps climbing, while 5 HCMC industrial fairs with 800+ exhibitors opened Nov 4, pointing to sourcing and capacity pressure.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國能源部長提議擴大全產業Direct PPA，過境輸電費初估每度1.40泰銖待ERC核定，製造業有望降低電力成本、紓解調價壓力。A3公布ISO 21423:2026，規範不同廠牌工業移動機器人的通訊與協同。BOI赴日路演，鎖定晶片、能源及新世代汽車投資。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's energy minister proposes expanding Direct PPA to all industries (wheeling fee ~1.40 THB/kWh, pending ERC), easing power-cost pressure. A3 released ISO 21423:2026 for multi-vendor mobile robot interoperability. BOI courts Japanese chip, energy and auto investment.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 泰國商務部聯合10個鋼鐵協會制定4項管制措施，防堵低價進口鋼材衝擊國內產業。對在泰華商製造業而言，鋼材進口管制可能改變原料取得管道與成本結構，採購部門需重新評估供應來源與議價策略。
th-huashang.summary_en: Thailand's Commerce Ministry and 10 steel associations set 4 control measures against low-priced steel imports. For Chinese-owned manufacturers in Thailand, this may shift steel sourcing and costs, so purchasing teams should review suppliers and negotiation plans.

vn-local.summary_zh: ECCO越南宣布解散，將於11月30日停止胡志明市Bàu Bàng工業區工廠生產，1,611名員工受影響，附近12家公司需招聘約6,500人，人力重新配置成為新痛點。越南首款自主安全晶片須加密設計檔後才送代工，凸顯技術外洩防護需求。同奈省減免工業區租金30%、Sacombank推7.9%貸款，可望緩解成本與融資壓力。
vn-local.summary_en: ECCO Vietnam will end production at its HCMC Bau Bang plant on Nov 30, affecting 1,611 staff while 12 nearby firms seek ~6,500 workers. Vietnam's first home-designed security chip needed encrypted design files for the fab. Dong Nai cut industrial land rent 30%; Sacombank offers 7.9% loans.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日越南年末出口訂單增加，「訂單增加、產能與人力跟不上」持續升溫；政府研議防範貿易欺詐決議草案，原產地文件核對壓力上升。另有ECCO越南廠解散停產、小型企業所得稅減免30%，財政部長亦要求本地企業提升配套能力，華商需同步檢視產能、合規與供應鏈。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Year-end export orders are rising, worsening capacity and labour gaps. Vietnam drafts a trade-fraud resolution, raising origin-document scrutiny. ECCO Vietnam dissolved its factory, small firms get a 30% income tax cut, and the finance minister urged local suppliers to upgrade.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國電動車政策轉向保護在地製造：財政部擬提高在泰組裝電動車消費稅並封堵「零美元工廠」漏洞，進口稅擬提高至35%，業者加速在泰設廠，廣汽電池包工廠已投產。另泰國抽查80家工廠，1家停工、63家限期改善，合規壓力浮現。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's EV policy tilts toward local manufacturing: higher excise on locally assembled EVs, closing 'zero-dollar factory' loopholes, a 35% import tax, and GAC's battery-pack plant now producing. Of 80 factories inspected, 1 was shut and 63 must fix issues by deadlines.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 泰國內閣批准自2027年1月1日起，將進口純電動車及增程式電動車消費稅統一上調至35%。工業部長也表示將保護本土產業，進口車未來稅負可能更高。中國品牌因此加速在泰設廠，廣汽首座海外自研電池包工廠已投產，對在泰華商的關稅成本與在地化供應鏈影響明顯。今日無新增或延續痛點。
th-huashang.summary_en: Thailand's cabinet will raise excise on imported BEVs and EREVs to 35% from 1 Jan 2027, and further protection for local industry is signalled. Chinese brands are speeding up local plants, and GAC's battery pack plant has started production. No pains were logged today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 越南10月製造業PMI升至52.3，但擴張放緩、出口訂單下降，投入成本與原料供應壓力持續（P030）。越南自2027年1月1日起禁止進口二手手機、電腦及部分電子零件，相關廠商需提前調整料源；同時機器人與自動化需求升溫，Geleximco要求自動化比例達60%。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam's October manufacturing PMI rose to 52.3, but growth slowed, export orders fell and input costs and supply issues persist. A ban on importing used phones, computers and some electronic parts starts 1 Jan 2027, forcing sourcing changes, while automation demand grows.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 台資企業持續加碼越南：光寶將注資3億2000萬（幣別未載明）擴充越南兩家子公司產能以因應AI基礎設施需求，昇達科第四季起推進台美越三地擴產，凸顯訂單成長下產能與人力的壓力。同時美國對越南智財調查將於29日截止，潛在新關稅與越南《投資法》修法草案，都可能影響華商的出口成本與投資布局。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Taiwanese firms expand in Vietnam: Lite On to inject 320 million (currency unstated) into two units for AI demand; Gold Bond (昇達科) scales up in Taiwan, US and Vietnam from Q4. A US IP probe on Vietnam closing on the 29th and Investment Law amendments may reshape export costs and investment plans.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點在供應鏈重組：泰國工業聯合會與電力局推動Local Content，讓本地廠商切入變壓器、開關設備等能源供應鏈；中國電動車企業計畫2027年在泰設廠。同時，歐盟網路安全法規（CRA、機械法規）對機械出口商帶來合規壓力，3D列印也被用來縮短零件成型時間，均影響泰國廠的供應商認證、交期與出口合規。
th-local.summary_en: Thai manufacturing news centres on supply chain shifts: FTI and the power authority push Local Content into energy equipment supply chains, and a Chinese EV maker plans a Thai plant in 2027. EU cybersecurity rules pressure machinery exporters, while 3D printing cuts part forming time.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日兩則訊號：據報導，惠普、華碩、宏碁將部分PC訂單從泰國、越南轉回中國，戴爾也在評估，在泰華商供應鏈面臨客戶產能轉移、產線需快速調整的壓力（新痛點P090）。同時中國電動車企業計畫2027年在泰國設廠，泰國汽車供應鏈可能出現新機會。
th-huashang.summary_en: Reports say HP, ASUS and Acer are moving some PC orders from Thailand and Vietnam back to China, with Dell assessing similar moves, pressuring Chinese-owned suppliers in Thailand to adjust lines fast (new pain P090). Meanwhile a Chinese EV maker plans a Thai plant in 2027.

vn-local.summary_zh: 越南電價下調2%、汽油特別消費稅降至0%，有助降低工廠生產與用電成本，電價議題持續受關注。同時同奈省推動數位轉型、強調實際成效，Phenikaa人造石自動化生產技術獲胡志明獎提名，自動化需求持續升溫。嘉萊省亦有石墨烯工廠啟用，投資202 tỉ越盾。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam cut electricity prices 2% and the petrol special consumption tax to 0%, easing production costs. Dong Nai pushes digital transformation focused on real results, Phenikaa's automated production research earned a Ho Chi Minh Prize nomination, and a graphene plant opened in Gia Lai.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
vn-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國環境部長宣布年底前將嚴查3,049家工廠的工業廢棄物管理，環保稽查趨嚴的痛點持續累積（本期共9次），製造商需盡快檢視廢棄物與排放管控流程。另東部經濟走廊前9個月新設企業7,491家、年減14.14%，註冊資本減少42.13%，顯示投資動能放緩。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's environment minister will inspect industrial waste management at 3,049 factories by year-end, adding to the recurring pressure from tighter environmental audits (9 mentions). Meanwhile, new EEC company registrations fell 14.14% in the first nine months and registered capital fell 42.13%.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: EVN自11月1日起電價平均調降2%，至每度約2,159.9越南盾（未含稅），工廠用電成本出現變化，是今日新痛點。機器人與自動化仍持續升溫，越南工業機器人市場2025年約1.12億美元，但具實作技能的人力缺口同步擴大。另有Spectre、Coherent等外資擴廠消息。
vn-local.summary_en: EVN cut average power tariffs 2% from Nov 1 to ~VND 2,159.9/kWh (pre-tax), a new cost factor for factories. Robotics demand keeps rising (VN industrial robot market ~US$112M in 2025) while skilled-labour gaps widen. Spectre and Coherent announced Vietnam expansions.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
vn-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國工業部長下令自11月1日起清查5府電子廢棄物工廠，違規者將被關廠，並修法加重罰則。環保稽查趨嚴（P034）持續發酵，在泰製造商需盡快檢視廢棄物與排放管控；另天災停工（P070）議題亦在上升。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's industry minister ordered inspections of e-waste factories in 5 provinces from Nov 1, with violators facing closure and tougher penalties via legal amendments. Stricter environmental enforcement (P034) persists; natural-disaster stoppages (P070) are rising.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 駐泰代表指出，中國加一策略持續推動台商布局泰國，並提醒重視非紅供應鏈與高階人才不足的挑戰，今日首次出現「高階人才不足」痛點。另有jpp-KY泰國子公司與地方政府合辦自動化與機器人競賽，顯示台商在泰投入在地人才培育。對赴泰製造商而言，人才與供應鏈布局是擴張關鍵。
th-huashang.summary_en: Taiwan's envoy to Thailand says China+1 is driving Taiwanese firms to Thailand, flagging non-red supply chains and senior talent gaps, a new pain today. jpp-KY's Thai unit co-hosted an automation and robotics contest with local government, signalling local talent investment.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日焦點在產能升級：SCG在越南推出年產5.5萬噸、大量導入機器人的塑膠廠，韓國VINATech計畫在興安省合併三廠為17.2萬平方米綜合廠，三星電機也在太原擴產AI伺服器電路板。法規方面，2027年起企業可自行認定並公告越南產品原產地；政府亦要求EVN研擬降電價方案。自動化與多廠整合需求升溫，原產地自主認定則考驗企業的資料追溯能力。
vn-local.summary_en: Capacity upgrades lead today: SCG opens a robot-heavy plastics plant, VINATech will merge three plants in Hung Yen, and Samsung Electro-Mechanics expands in Thai Nguyen. From 2027, firms can self-certify origin of Vietnam-made goods. EVN was asked to draft a power price cut.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南擬自2027年1月1日起禁止進口部分二手數位產品，包括二手手機與電腦（HS 8517、8471），華商廠的採購與關務需逐項核對HS編碼與禁令範圍。另外，丹麥Spectre集團在興安省茶江工業園的第四座越南工廠已竣工。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam plans to ban imports of some used digital products, including used phones and computers (HS 8517, 8471), from 1 Jan 2027. Chinese-owned plants should check HS codes and ban scope item by item. Denmark's Spectre also completed its fourth Vietnam factory, in Hung Yen.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國商務部要求製造商維持售價，罐頭魚等品項面臨漲價壓力，能源運輸成本問題持續。羅勇府查獲逾千噸非法電子廢棄物，環保稽查趨嚴。另Betagro加速拓展寵物食品OEM出口至美國與印度，9月通訊設備產值因數據中心需求增長50%，出口與市場開發成為新焦點。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's Commerce Ministry asked makers to hold prices as canned fish faces cost pressure. Over 1,000 tons of illegal e-waste were seized in Rayong. Betagro is expanding pet-food OEM exports to the US and India, and September communications equipment output rose 50% on data center demand.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日此層級僅有1則資訊，且無新增、重複或上升的痛點。泰國媒體報導鴻海董事長表示，目標成為全球最大量子電腦製造商，將承接量子電腦組裝與製造，可作為台資大廠布局新興產業的動態參考，但尚未直接反映在泰華商製造業者的營運痛點上。
th-huashang.summary_en: Only one item today and no new, recurring or rising pains. A Thai outlet reports Foxconn's chairman aims to become the world's largest quantum computer maker, taking on assembly and manufacturing. It signals a Taiwanese giant's move into emerging tech, but no direct pain for Thai Chinese-owned makers yet.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日無新痛點，四項既有痛點持續：鋼價十月下半月同步上漲，壓縮獲利；出口製造業被要求提升國內附加價值、切入全球供應鏈；GRECO 2026展出人形與服務機器人，自動化需求升溫。Nike等推出零直排電動駁船，顯示出口供應鏈減碳要求正落地。勞工短缺與技能不足也列為上升痛點。
vn-local.summary_en: No new pains today. Steel prices rose in late October, squeezing margins. Exporters are urged to raise local value-add in global supply chains. GRECO 2026 showcased robots as automation demand rises. Nike's zero-emission e-barge signals supply-chain decarbonisation. Labour shortage and skills gaps are rising.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日VN華商層面有3則相關消息：中國承包商拿下同奈省約8.33億美元礬土加工廠EPC工程；國會審議《土地法（修正案）》與《中小企業發展法》草案，涉及土地價格表調整；國際能源署呼籲擴大CCUS，越南同步加快工業減排。減碳合規壓力（P040）持續上升，外籍員工工作許可核對（P069）亦升溫，華商需留意土地成本與ESG合規。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Three items today: a Chinese contractor won a ~US$833M EPC deal for a Dong Nai alumina plant; the National Assembly is reviewing Land Law amendments and an SME law draft, including land price tables; the IEA urges scaling CCUS as Vietnam speeds industrial emission cuts. Decarbonisation pressure (P040) keeps rising.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國今日焦點：商務部與10個鋼鐵協會研議反傾銷措施，8個月鋼材進口達798,584噸；工業聯合會與14家車廠推動新消費稅制以提高本地含量，製造商貿易合規與供應鏈在地化壓力上升。同時NetSuite以Agentic AI縮短ERP導入時間，Fuji測試大型晶片自動化SMT組裝，反映數位化與產線自動化需求。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand weighs anti-dumping steps after 798,584 tonnes of steel imports in 8 months, while FTI and 14 carmakers push a new excise scheme to raise local content. NetSuite claims AI cuts ERP go-live to weeks, and Fuji tests automated SMT for 1.3 kg chips, signaling compliance and automation needs.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日泰國華商動態聚焦擴產與高階認證：jpp-KY經寶精密通過空中巴士關鍵特殊製程驗證，並因AI與航太訂單預估明年營收雙位數成長、將加大泰國投資；海爾投資52.5億銖於羅勇府建洗衣機廠；泰國副總理亦率中國投資者考察宋卡府，評估無人機與機器人生產基地。顯示客戶對海外產能與嚴格品質驗證的要求同步升高。
th-huashang.summary_en: Chinese-owned makers deepen Thailand bets: jpp-KY passed Airbus special-process validation and will expand Thai investment on AI/aerospace orders; Haier invests THB5.25bn in a Rayong washer plant; Chinese investors eye Songkhla for drones and robotics. Overseas capacity and strict certification matter.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日新浮現痛點：16家越南企業透過智慧工廠顧問計畫提升生產效率，顯示中小製造業升級需求。成本壓力仍是主軸，VinEnergo直接供電VinFast工廠以節省電費；VINATech整併三座工廠、Geleximco與Chery合建汽車廠，凸顯擴張時數據與流程統一的挑戰。
vn-local.summary_en: 16 Vietnamese firms raised productivity via a smart-factory consulting program, a new SME upgrade signal. Cost pressure persists: VinEnergo now powers VinFast plants directly to cut power bills. VINATech's three-plant consolidation highlights multi-site data and process unification.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日焦點：華碩、宏碁、惠普因AI推升零組件成本，將部分PC生產從泰國與越南遷回中國大陸，越南華商需重新評估代工產能布局與成本。越南第393/2026號法令將於12月5日生效，規範外籍勞工（在越南工作的外國人）工作許可延期流程；滅火器造假案則凸顯供應商原料與進料檢驗風險。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Asus, Acer and HP are moving some PC output from Thailand and Vietnam back to mainland China as AI lifts component costs, prompting capacity reassessment. Decree 393/2026 on work permit extensions for foreign workers in Vietnam takes effect Dec 5; a fire extinguisher fraud case flags supplier quality risk.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：工廠投資增加但就業減少，自動化下人才轉型壓力持續升溫；中小企業協會警告柴油漲價推高運輸與生產成本。另寵物食品OEM廠被鼓勵轉型自有品牌以提升出口價值，汽車廠則在東部洪水退去後加速復產，顯示產能與交期韌性仍是關鍵。
th-local.summary_en: Thai factories invest more but hire fewer, raising pressure to reskill for automation and AI. SMEs warn rising diesel prices lift transport and production costs. Pet-food OEMs are urged to build own brands, while automakers speed output after eastern floods recede.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 政府要求研議自11月1日起調降平均零售電價，Agribank與VietinBank也下調生產經營貸款利率（低至年息6%），有助緩解製造業能源與融資成本壓力。同時，湄公河三角洲缺工持續，勞工表示若家鄉有工業區職缺便願留鄉；AI將工程圖轉為生產指令、本地企業切入FDI供應鏈等議題也受關注。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam plans to study cutting retail electricity prices from Nov 1, and Agribank and VietinBank cut production loan rates (as low as 6%/yr), easing cost pressure. Mekong Delta labour shortages persist, while AI drawing-to-instruction tools and FDI supply chain entry draw attention.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日峴港公安突擊檢查工業區工地，查獲26名中國籍人員無工作許可證，提醒華商定期核對外籍勞工（在越南工作的外國人）的工作許可。同塔省多家企業投資屋頂太陽能以符合出口綠色標準，減碳合規壓力持續上升；另有AI工具將工程圖轉生產指令時間由45小時縮至45秒，關稅調整議題也持續升溫。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Da Nang police found 26 Chinese nationals without work permits at industrial park sites, a reminder to check foreign workers' permits regularly. Dong Thap firms adopt rooftop solar to meet green export standards, and an AI tool cuts drawing-to-instruction time from 45 hours to 45 seconds.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國9月汽車產量受洪水衝擊年減6.08%，天災停工首度成為新痛點，產能與交期管理受考驗；國內銷售年增14.28%，主要來自電動車。工業部將自11月2日起稽查1,500家廢棄物工廠，環保合規壓力持續升高。東部經濟走廊委員會另批准4個新投資區，總額256.6億泰銖。
th-local.summary_en: Floods cut Thai September auto output 6.08% YoY, making disaster-driven stoppages a new pain for capacity and delivery planning. From Nov 2 the Industry Ministry will inspect 1,500 waste factories, raising compliance pressure. The EEC approved 4 new investment zones worth THB 25.66bn.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點：一家未具名企業訂購1,000台中國產工業機器人，當地機器人市場預估年增近13%，自動化需求浮現；Agribank降息最多2.0%/年，可望緩解長期偏高的融資成本。另腰果原料進口值已超過出口值，加工利潤受壓；Lê Minh Xuân擴建工業區近100公頃擬轉為社會住宅用地，廠房擴建空間恐受限。
vn-local.summary_en: An unnamed firm ordered 1,000 Chinese industrial robots as Vietnam's robot market eyes ~13% annual growth. Agribank cut lending rates by up to 2.0%/yr, easing financing costs. Cashew raw imports now exceed exports, squeezing margins, and ~100 ha of industrial land may shift to social housing.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日越南華商製造業面臨三項新痛點：越南首座晶片廠恐難達成明年試產目標、尚未敲定ASML設備採購；第292/2026號法令規範暫時進口再出口許可申請；第283號法令自9月10日起加重勞安罰則，企業最高罰1.5億越盾。同時喬山北寧廠已啟用，關稅調整與減碳合規壓力持續升溫，顯示投資擴張與合規管理需同步強化。
vn-huashang.summary_en: New pains for Chinese-owned makers in Vietnam: the first chip fab may miss next year's trial run with ASML gear unconfirmed, Decree 292/2026 sets temporary import/re-export permit rules, and Decree 283 raises safety fines to VND150m. Tariff and decarbonisation pressure keeps rising.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點在投資與供應鏈調整：BOI前9個月投資額逾1.7兆泰銖、年增28%，EEC新增4個特別經濟促進區；本田計畫委託三菱於林查班工廠代工皮卡，反映代工夥伴擴增、產能配置需調整。另南奔府中小企業支持將大型零售商農產品付款期限限制在30天內，顯示現金流仍是關注重點。
th-local.summary_en: Thai investment momentum continues: BOI pledges topped THB1.7tn in 9 months (+28%) and the EEC added 4 special promotion zones. Honda will outsource pickup production to Mitsubishi at Laem Chabang, signalling OEM capacity shifts. SMEs backed a 30-day payment cap on large retailers to ease cash flow.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南在地製造業出現新痛點：出入境管理部門突擊檢查某工業區企業，並表示將加強後續查核與違規處理，聘有外籍勞工（在越南工作的外國人）的工廠需盡快檢視人資合規。另外，歐洲航太零件商 ASCO 擬在峴港投資約2,000萬美元設廠，未來可能增至1億美元；Victoria's Secret 合作代工廠在海防與興安約有2.9萬名員工，越南廠貢獻其營收83%，顯示外資持續深化在越生產。
vn-local.summary_en: New pain today: immigration authorities raided a firm in an industrial zone and will step up checks, so plants employing foreign workers in Vietnam should review compliance. ASCO plans a $20M (up to $100M) aerospace parts plant in Da Nang; a Victoria's Secret supplier's Vietnam plants make 83% of its revenue.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅1則相關消息：海防市表示將加強外籍勞工（在越南工作的外國人）管理，並推動物流、工業與進出口發展，派駐台籍、陸籍幹部的華商廠應留意人資合規。今日無新增或重複痛點；近期上升痛點以關稅調整影響出口成本與接單（7次）居首，其次為減碳合規與產能人力不足。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Light day: one item. Hai Phong says it will tighten management of foreign workers in Vietnam while promoting logistics, industry and import-export, so Chinese-owned plants with expat staff should watch HR compliance. No new pains; rising: tariff costs (7), decarbonisation, capacity/labour.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國總理強調外資須進行技術轉移並提升勞工技能，並稱上半年FDI成長約30%，呼應自動化投資增加但人才技能升級不足的持續痛點。另五十鈴推出2.2 Biturbo新引擎，稱國內零件使用率逾90%，顯示在地供應鏈深化。今日僅2則來自單一來源的報導，訊號有限。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's PM urged foreign investors to transfer technology and upskill workers, citing ~30% H1 FDI growth, echoing the recurring automation-vs-skills gap pain. Isuzu launched a new 2.2 Biturbo engine with over 90% local parts. Only 2 items from one source today.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。
th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 越南修訂投資法，目標簡化投資程序並強化供應鏈實質化，回應擴廠審批繁瑣的新痛點；Agribank下調現有貸款利率最多2.5%，緩解持續升溫的融資成本壓力。湄公河三角洲缺工、自動化技能人才不足仍是製造業持續面對的人力挑戰。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam is amending its Investment Law to simplify procedures, addressing a new pain on slow expansion approvals. Agribank cut existing loan rates by up to 2.5%, easing rising financing costs. Labour shortages in the Mekong Delta and automation skill gaps persist.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日無新痛點，三項既有痛點持續升溫：成衣大廠儒鴻訂單能見度已達明年第二季，產能與人力壓力浮現；美國調整對加拿大關稅範圍，鋼價升至多年新高，牽動採購成本。越南修訂投資法轉向重視技術轉讓與質量，日本FDI推動綠色轉型，華商需提早因應減碳合規。
vn-huashang.summary_en: No new pains; three recurring ones rose. Eclat's order visibility reaches Q2 next year, straining capacity and labour. US tariff changes on Canada pushed steel to multi-year highs. Vietnam's investment law revision favours quality and tech transfer, while Japanese FDI drives green transition.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國在地層僅2則相關新聞。CPF主張泰國食品業應以AI提升附加價值與生產力，而非只追求產量，帶出新痛點P057；另有一處橡膠園改建為約1,300億泰銖的工業區，第三期開發瞄準全球供應鏈，顯示產業用地與供應鏈布局持續擴張。
th-local.summary_en: Only 2 relevant items today. CPF urged Thai food makers to use AI to raise value and productivity, not just volume (new pain P057). A rubber plantation is becoming a ~THB 130bn industrial estate, with phase 3 targeting global supply chains.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在擴廠投資與資金成本：Carlsberg計畫2026至2031年投資約6,500萬美元於富白啤酒廠，推動生產現代化與數位、綠色轉型；Biel Crystal再投資近5億美元擴建海防廠。MB銀行最多降息2%/年，緩解融資壓力；湄公河三角洲則出現新痛點：缺乏具實作與外語能力、能配合自動化的勞工。
vn-local.summary_en: Expansion and financing dominate: Carlsberg plans ~US$65M for Phu Bai brewery modernisation with digital and green transition; Biel Crystal adds ~US$500M in Hai Phong. MB cuts loan rates up to 2%/yr. New pain: Mekong Delta lacks skilled, foreign-language workers for automated factories.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日越南華商製造業重點：北寧省兩大工業園區突擊檢查11家企業，8家因環境違規遭罰逾11億越南盾，減碳與環保合規壓力持續升溫。香港Biel Crystal再投資近5億美元擴建海防廠，國會同時審議投資法、企業所得稅法修正草案，影響在越投資與稅務規劃。關稅調整議題亦持續升溫。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Bac Ninh inspected 11 firms in two industrial parks; 8 were fined over VND1.1bn for environmental violations, raising compliance pressure. Biel Crystal adds ~US$500m in Hai Phong, and the National Assembly is reviewing Investment and CIT law amendments. Tariff concerns keep rising.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國工業部派出50組團隊突擊檢查5府1,500家工廠，違規者可能遭勒令停工或吊銷許可，環保稽查壓力持續升高。另有Credit Term新規將於11月2日生效，付款期限上限為30天（農產品）或45天（商業、生產與服務），企業需重新檢視現金流。農業部則支持碾米廠推動稻穀大數據與統一標準。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's Industry Ministry sent 50 teams to inspect 1,500 factories in 5 provinces, with possible shutdowns or licence revocation. New credit-term rules take effect Nov 2, capping payment at 30 days (agri) or 45 days (commerce, production, services). Rice mills get backing for paddy big data and unified standards.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在融資與綠色轉型：Techcombank、越南外貿銀行推出生產經營優惠信貸，回應持續升溫的融資成本痛點。綠色基礎設施成為工業區選址要件，機電與紡織回收業面臨新標準壓力；湄公河三角洲勞工短缺推高留才成本，機器人取代組裝人力需求升高。
vn-local.summary_en: Banks (Techcombank, Vietcombank) rolled out lower-rate production loans as financing costs stay a top pain. Green infrastructure is becoming a site-selection criterion, while mechanical-electrical and textile recycling face green standards. Mekong labour shortages raise retention costs and automation demand.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南與EFTA四國於10月18日正式簽署VEFTA自貿協定，削減關稅並打開高購買力市場，但華商須符合原產地與可追溯要求，關稅與接單策略議題持續升溫。另越南國會討論增設7月27日為法定帶薪假（仍屬建議階段），可能影響生產排程與出勤；原料依賴進口的供應不穩問題亦持續出現。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam signed the VEFTA FTA with four EFTA states on Oct 18, cutting tariffs but requiring rules-of-origin and traceability compliance. A proposed new paid holiday on July 27 (still a proposal) may affect scheduling, while import-dependent raw material supply remains a recurring pain.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國出口預估2026年成長17.8%、2027年放緩至7.4%，BOI力推AI伺服器、PCB與EMS供應鏈及五大產業轉型。正大集團、CIIM等與政府合作培育AI與數據工程人才，凸顯自動化投資下的技能缺口；工業總會則指成本持續攀升。蘋果擴增iPhone 18 Pro零組件夥伴，代工廠需重新調整產能配置。
th-local.summary_en: Thai exports forecast +17.8% in 2026, slowing to 7.4% in 2027; BOI pushes AI server, PCB and EMS supply chains. Talent programs target automation skill gaps, costs keep rising, and Apple adding iPhone 18 Pro component partners means suppliers must rethink capacity allocation.

th-huashang.summary_en: No new relevant items today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點仍在原料供應：紡織業原輔料瓶頸限制自貿協定紅利，海運運費上漲推高成本。越南與EFTA協定帶來新市場，但要求品質與永續供應鏈；塑膠業與工業場域儲能顯示綠色轉型持續推進。外資加碼半導體封測，供應鏈多元化帶來高附加價值投資機會。
vn-local.summary_en: Raw material bottlenecks remain the key issue: textile input shortages limit FTA gains, and soaring freight lifts costs. The Vietnam–EFTA deal opens markets but demands quality and sustainable supply chains, while plastics and industrial solar-storage show green transition advancing.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國今日：50億泰銖有機肥投資因法規審批受阻，部分工廠已關閉；商業部要求業者在能源與運輸成本上升下緩漲價，壓縮製造商利潤。環保稽查與廢棄物管控持續升溫，化學廢棄物再利用成為話題；雀巢則投資230億泰銖興建新咖啡廠，顯示投資仍在進行。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand: regulatory delays stalled a THB5bn organic fertiliser investment and closed some plants; the Commerce Ministry urges producers to hold prices despite rising energy and transport costs. Environmental compliance pressure keeps rising, while Nestlé breaks ground on a THB23bn coffee plant.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關訊息：加高電子於法說會表示泰國新廠已啟用，以滿足客戶海外生產需求，並聚焦AI光通訊、智慧眼鏡與智慧汽車應用。這反映客戶要求海外產能的壓力，正推動台商在泰國建立跨國生產能力，跨廠協同與管理需求隨之浮現。
th-huashang.summary_en: Only one relevant item today: Kaikao Electronics said its new Thailand plant is operational to meet customers' overseas production needs, focusing on AI optical communication, smart glasses and smart vehicles. Customer demand for overseas capacity is pushing cross-border production in Thailand.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在供應鏈門檻升級：越南-EFTA協定要求更嚴格的品質與永續標準，中國擬管制12項太陽能設備技術出口，原料與設備取得風險升高。同時本地企業切入外資供應鏈（瑞士支持、廣寧建資料庫）與融資成本（HDBank降息信貸）持續受關注，Casumina因成本與財務費用大增而虧損。
vn-local.summary_en: Supply-chain bars rose today: Vietnam-EFTA FTA favors chains meeting stricter quality and sustainability rules, while China plans export curbs on 12 solar equipment technologies. Linking local firms to FDI chains and high financing costs stay hot; Casumina posted a loss on surging costs.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南與歐洲自由貿易聯盟（EFTA）於10月18日簽署自貿協定，涵蓋關稅、服務與投資，關稅調整對出口成本與接單策略的影響持續升溫。同時胡志明市舉辦機電業綠色轉型研討會，減碳合規成為華商製造業新增痛點，經營與ESG部門需及早因應。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam signed an FTA with EFTA on Oct 18 covering tariffs, services and investment, keeping tariff-driven export cost and order strategy concerns rising. A HCMC seminar on green transformation in the mechanical-electrical sector flags carbon compliance as a new pain for Chinese-owned manufacturers.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國政府加速處理普拉恰武里石油外洩，將嚴格管控高風險工廠，環保稽查壓力持續上升（P034）。另有大型民企示警AI投資增加但招聘有限，人才技能升級成新痛點；BOI則推動資料中心與AI供應鏈承接全球投資。製造商需同步強化排放管控與人才轉型。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand is tightening control of high-risk factories after the Prachinburi oil spill, so environmental enforcement pressure keeps rising. Big firms warn AI investment outpaces hiring and urge faster reskilling. BOI pushes data centers and the AI supply chain to capture global investment.

vn-local.summary_zh: 越南國家銀行要求銀行對生產經營貸款降息1.5–2%，VietinBank、LPBank、Sacombank已跟進，融資成本壓力可望緩解。同時政府要求外資加強與本地企業連結，Vingroup以租金減半吸引本土供應商。LION電纜導入SAP Cloud ERP統一數據流程，顯示擴張中的管理整合需求。
vn-local.summary_en: SBV urged banks to cut production loan rates 1.5–2%; VietinBank, LPBank and Sacombank followed, easing financing pressure. Vietnam pushes FDI–local linkages, with Vingroup halving land rent for local suppliers. LION Cable's SAP Cloud ERP rollout shows data unification needs when scaling.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 瑞軒光通訊產品線通過客戶認證，將在越南廠區招募人才並擴產，凸顯訂單增加後產能與人力跟不上的新挑戰。越南與歐洲自由貿易聯盟四國簽署自貿協定，關稅調整議題持續升溫，影響華商出口成本與接單策略。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Amtran's optical communication line passed customer certification and will hire and expand at its Vietnam plant, highlighting capacity and staffing strain. Vietnam signed an FTA with the four EFTA states, keeping tariff shifts affecting export costs and order strategy in focus.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國焦點在環保稽查：普拉千武府一工廠被查出囤放逾1,200噸電子廢棄物並侵占森林保留區，居民發起1,300人連署要求關廠清運，顯示廢棄物與排放管控壓力升高，製造商需強化合規追蹤。另BOI支持豐田14.9億泰銖氫能Hilux投資案。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand: a Prachinburi factory was found storing 1,200+ tonnes of e-waste on forest reserve land, and residents are gathering 1,300 signatures to close it, signaling stricter environmental scrutiny. Separately, BOI backed Toyota's THB1.49bn hydrogen Hilux investment.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日三則報導聚焦同一事件：中國車企大舉赴泰國設廠，中國電動車在泰市占率四年內從趨近於零升至逾八成（一則報導為85%）。這顯示中資車廠正快速在泰落地，與TH華商製造業的布局動向直接相關。今日無新增或延續的痛點資料。
th-huashang.summary_en: All three items cover one story: Chinese automakers are building plants in Thailand en masse, and Chinese EVs' Thai market share rose from near zero to over 80% (one report says 85%) in four years. This is relevant to Chinese-owned manufacturers in Thailand. No pain data today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日僅有兩則來自thanhnien.vn的新訊號：越南FDI流入創新高，但本土企業融入外資供應鏈的程度仍不足；同時政府要求銀行將生產與優先領域貸款利率調降1.5至2個百分點。對製造商而言，這代表切入外資供應鏈的機會與門檻並存，融資成本壓力則可能稍獲緩解。
vn-local.summary_en: Two new signals from thanhnien.vn: record FDI inflows, yet local firms remain weakly linked to foreign-invested supply chains; and the government asked banks to cut lending rates for production and priority sectors by 1.5–2 points. Supply-chain entry and financing costs are today's focus.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關訊息：越南與四個非歐盟歐洲國家於河內簽署自由貿易協定，相互取消或降低工業、海產及農產品關稅。對在越華商製造業而言，這可能改變出口成本結構與接單策略，財務與業務部門宜及早評估新市場機會。
vn-huashang.summary_en: One relevant item today: Vietnam signed an FTA in Hanoi with four non-EU European countries, cutting or removing tariffs on industrial, seafood and farm goods. For Chinese-owned manufacturers in Vietnam, this may reshape export costs and order strategy.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國在地層僅有一則訊息，沒有新增或持續中的痛點。EASTERN ELECTRONICS (THAILAND) 在春武里府阿瑪塔城工業區招聘中英泰口譯人員，屬單一人資招聘消息，尚不足以判斷趨勢。
th-local.summary_en: A quiet day for the Thailand layer: one item and no new or recurring pains. EASTERN ELECTRONICS (THAILAND) is hiring a Chinese-English-Thai interpreter in Amata City, Chonburi. This is a single HR posting and not enough to signal a trend.
